newsitem.title: UK: L Gardner gains on results, acquisition.
newsitem.headline: L Gardner gains on results, acquisition.

text.p: Shares in L Gardner Group Plc rose on Wednesday after the engineering group posted sharply higher profits and said it planned to acquire precision parts manufacturer Sloman Engineering Ltd.
Gardner, floated a year ago, said the first two months of the current year had started well, helping send the shares up 11p to 205-1/2p by 1230 GMT in trading volume of 26,600 shares.

"Sloman Engineering will complement our existing engineering business, with its specialist manufacture of precision components for the automotive and diesel engine industries," said Gardner chief executive Roger Newton.
The acquisition is to be financed through a placing and open offer of new shares to raise 5.3 million stg net.
Gardner posted a 38.8 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 2.5 million stg in the year ended August 31, up from 1.8 million a year before and announced a maiden dividend of 6p.
"The first two months of the current financial year have started well, with the Group achieving expected levels of order intake," said non-executive chairman Michael McDonald.
Earnings per share rose to 15.6p from 12.5p and turnover increased to 22.0 million stg from 16.5 million.
